This master services agreement (the "Agreement") is entered into as of 09/01/2026 (the "Effective Date") by and
between Westbrook Pharma Ltd, with its registered office at 221 Baker Street, Leeds ("Party A"), and Westbrook Pharma
Ltd, with its registered office at Unit 7, Riverside Estate, Leeds ("Party B").

1. Term

This Agreement shall remain in force for a period of 12 months from the Effective Date unless terminated earlier in
accordance with Section 7.

2. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep confidential all non-public information received from the other party and shall use it solely for the
purposes of this Agreement.

3. Governing Law

This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of Switzerland.
